Query: which type of online advertising is extended by the same type?
Rationale: The Candidate fails to capture the multi-hop topology required by the Ground Truth LISP. The LISP specifies a two-hop traversal: a 'Type' that extends an entity, which in turn extends 'Online_Advertising' (Type $\to$ Extends $\to$ X $\to$ Extends $\to$ Online_Advertising). The Candidate instead models a single-hop relationship between two 'OnlineAdvertising' entities and uses an attribute comparison (`e1.type == e2.type`) to attempt to satisfy the 'same type' part of the query. This structural mismatch (1 hop vs 2 hops) means the core intent of the traversal is not met.
